citation.title: AI-Based Topology Optimization of Freehand Sketches
citation.authors: Enno Garrelts, Marco F. Huber, Daniel Roth, Hansgeorg Binz
citation.venue: Procedia CIRP 104 (2021) 1316-1321 (Crossref; conference proceedings, CC BY 4.0 per Crossref and OpenAlex)
citation.version_coded: none: only the abstract was read (pool record from OpenAlex). Neither the version of record nor the Fraunhofer repository copy could be retrieved

claim.primary_outcome_paraphrase: Not coded (no accessible full text). Abstract only: a neural network reads photographed design sketches and generates lightweight structures matching the sketched load cases; the abstract states no comparison with a classical method.
claim.claimed_speedup_basis: Not coded; the abstract gives no numbers and no comparison.
claim.alternatives: Abstract: the stated findings are an intuitive designer-AI interface, ways to implement the tool, and how to structure and train the network.
